_doc: Fixed chat eval set (CC-6). expect: 'some' = 3-5 cards (fewer only when fewer are feasible), 'none' = 0, 'any' = 0-5. journey_type is sent as context.journeyType and drives the Jewel rule (standing decision, 3 Oct): connecting needs 180+ min to boarding, departing 90+ min and the reply must say 'before immigration', just_landed always; an unknown type is scored under the connecting rule when minutes are known, and with no minutes Jewel is allowed if the reply says it's landside/outside immigration (Todd, 4 Oct). minutes_to_boarding is the scoring minutes (null = unknown). boarding_in_minutes sets context.flight.boardingTime relative to the run. A Jewel card can only appear when no terminal is pinned: a pinned terminal filters the pool to that terminal. Location: a reply must never place the user somewhere other than their known location (context.terminal or an explicit "I'm at/in"); l1/l2 test it.
